title: What Scripture Actually Means by Take Every Thought Captive
caption:
Take every thought captive isn't a verse about staying positive.

It's a verse about timing. By the time you're deciding whether to act, the fight's already lost.

2 Corinthians 10:5 says take the thought captive, not the action. Catch it three seconds earlier.

Start in the quiet minutes before it ever shows up.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #scripture
